messages.subject: oSCR version 0.30 released: fully integrated telemetry, multiple core multi-model fitting, +++
messages.subject_clean: oSCR version 0.30 released: fully integrated telemetry, multiple core multi-model fitting, +++
messages.body_plain:
hi all,
 I posted version 0.30 of oSCR on the webpage.  We added a couple of major things recently including fully integrated telemetry data with the SCR likelihood (see ?telemetry) thanks to Dan Linden and oSCR.parfit for fitting multiple models simultaneously on multiple cores.

 A few other minor improvements and bug fixes. We're still lagging on documentation but will be improving that over the next month or so.

regards
andy
